summary: This is an 8-K filed by Ellington Financial Inc. reporting a routine monthly common dividend declaration of $0.13 per share, payable on June 30, 2026, to holders of record on May 29, 2026. The filing includes a press release and standard boilerplate forward-looking cautionary language. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, activist campaign, or management change. This filing is a routine current report regarding a regular dividend.
